# Competitor notes, kiln controllers

## Firewise

Firewise sells the FW-200 controller for small pottery kilns. The FW-200 costs $349 per unit. It connects over Wi-Fi and keeps a firing log.

## Kilnmate

Kilnmate offers the KM Pro at $279 per unit, with Bluetooth only. A cloud log plan is $5 per month.

## Glazeline

Glazeline lists its GL-1 at $415 per unit with Wi-Fi and a touch screen.
